create.name: Felicity Weston
create.bio:
Felicity Weston is a Reiki Master Teacher and ceremonial healer who founded the ookushana School of Healing. Its home is a small wellness studio in Chapel Allerton, north Leeds, where she and a circle of other practitioners hold sound baths, women's circles, Reiki shares, breathwork and cacao ceremonies. She describes her own path as that of a medicine woman, centred on feminine alchemy, ritual and ancestral work, and she has spent more than a decade studying with a range of schools, traditions and mentors.

Her teaching runs on two tracks. In person she trains students in Usui Reiki from the first level through to Master and Teacher, and runs an experiential course on creating ceremony and ritual. Online she leads Medicine Woman, an eighteen-month practitioner journey for women with two residential gatherings, and a self-paced course on the foundations of holistic and ritual healing that she co-teaches with her husband, the coach Joe Aston, and guest teachers. In her one-to-one ceremonies she works with her hands and voice, sound instruments, plant allies and intuitive perception rather than a fixed method. She also guides small seasonal retreats at sacred sites in England, such as Glastonbury.

courses.title: Usui Reiki Training: Level 1 to Master Teacher
courses.description: One-day, in-person Usui Reiki trainings at the Leeds studio, taken in stages from Level 1 through Level 2 to the Master and Teacher attunement. Each level combines theory, attunement and supervised practice; dates are announced on the page.

courses.title: Medicine Woman Practitioner Training
courses.description: An eighteen-month training for women, mostly online with two all-inclusive residential gatherings, in ritual, feminine alchemy and ancestral work. The next cohort starts in February 2027.

courses.title: The Fundamentals Of Holistic & Ritualistic Healing
courses.description: A self-paced online course of twelve recorded masterclasses with workbooks, taught by Felicity, Joe Aston and two guest practitioners. It sets out foundations for people working with energy and ritual, for themselves or for others.

courses.title: 1-2-1 Lightworker Mentorship
courses.description: A one-to-one mentoring journey over several weeks or months, mainly on Zoom, for practitioners who want support in developing their gifts and their work.

flags: Email hello@ookushana.com is the school's inbox (published on the contact page), not a personal address.

Base recorded as Leeds: the school's studio is in Chapel Allerton, Leeds (ookushana-leeds page; site title 'Leeds, Yorkshire'). Her mentorship page offers in-person sessions in Dorset and her husband's hikes run in Yorkshire and Dorset, so she may now live in Dorset; a human may want to confirm.

Much of the site's one-to-one and retreat work is framed as womb healing (including healing from birth or sexual trauma and preparing the body for new life); all of that is left out under the health rule, which leaves four offerings. A human may want to judge whether the remaining work is enough for a page.
Some offerings lean towards business coaching for practitioners (Leaders of Light, Abundance Alchemy, wealth container); only the mentorship is kept and the rest left out.

Only one photo used: the 2024 portrait whose file name names her (Ste Marques Photography, 'FelicityW'). A second picture labelled 'felicity1' shows a woman with different hair colour at a ceremony; not used as identity could not be confirmed.
Her husband Joe Aston (men's shamanic life coach) co-teaches some courses; he is mentioned in the bio, not listed separately.
Fundamentals course is on sale at £499 GBP; the full published price £999 GBP is used. Medicine Woman lists several payment plans; the full price and pay-in-one price are both given.
The mentorship page still shows 2023 start text and prices; the current online page offers 3-, 6- or 12-month mentorships, so the price is set to 'Contact for pricing'.
